messages:
lena (partnerships): Quick recap from Nimbus call — they proposed a time-of-day blended reserve (night discount + daytime spot). Need numbers for cost model.
omar (nimbus): Summary: monthly baseline guaranteed GPU-hrs + night-band (00:00-08:00 local) at ~40% off. daytime extra = spot with dynamic multiplier. Billing monthly; invoice lag 14-30d by tier.
chris (finance): Please provide: baseline USD/hr, night-band USD/hr, spot baseline USD/hr, multiplier formula, volume tiers, and mark guaranteed vs indicative.
omar (nimbus): Baseline and night-band guaranteed up to commit. Spot indicative; we publish 1h median + 95p historical.
maya (product): Can we tag routes to prefer night-band for batch jobs? Also need baseline SLA text.
omar (nimbus): Yes — SKU tags support time-window routing. SLA: 99.9% monthly on committed baseline; credits pro-rated.
drew (eng): How do we observe capacity? API or stream? heartbeat cadence?
omar (nimbus): /availability/current and /availability/history endpoints. Websocket optional (1m cadence recommended). Soft-drain notice ~15s; hard eviction immediate. Webhooks supported.
sara (legal): We'll need pilot T&Cs, credit calc, and an indemnity clause for hardware faults. Also clarify co-announcement/embargo terms.
lena (partnerships): Modeling asks: include scenarios — night-shift uptake (60% of flex moves to night-band), low uptake, spot spike +5x for 12h, sustained +2x for 72h. Map invoice lag to cashflow timing.
chris (finance): Also request volume discount breakpoints and explicit spot multiplier examples.
omar (nimbus): High-demand defined as utilization >85% across pools. Multiplier = max(1, base_spot * (1 + (util-0.85)*10)). We'll attach a table.
lena (partnerships): Deliverables due Friday: hourly availability CSV, rate table JSON schema, sample SLA text, webhook examples, and FAQs. Mark guaranteed vs indicative.
omar (nimbus): Will deliver by COB Friday.
drew (eng): We'll prototype a websocket parser and webhook consumer once payloads arrive.
sara (legal): Schedule 30m to review pilot terms.
lena (partnerships): Thanks — follow-up meeting Monday 10am PT. Closing thread.
